title: Prove the alternate shared-port transfer and binary obstruction
body:
## Summary

PR3547's explicit failed shared-port star admits a different characteristic-two support transfer. This closes its exact marks E,F / ports G,F+G alternate-map handoff.

```text
same old star: d,b,t,h,x,y
old supplied GF4 map: d' = e+f+w g   -> fails a reader implication
new GF4 map:          d' = e+w f     -> all marked implications hold
binary target field: no map exists in any ambient dimension
```

The written proof constructs a transfer over every characteristic-two field larger than F2 and excludes all F2 transfers. The new map preserves the actual-reader pair floor for arbitrary finite three-terminal graph attachments at these exact ports. It extends a scoped lower-bound family; no cheaper decoder, physical supplier, kappa gain or selected-frontier change is claimed.

All changes are in `research/p112-alternate-star-transfer/`. The exact pending PR3547 witness is retained byte-for-byte with original commit/path/blob/SHA256 and credit. The used support-to-tariff proof is a pinned canonical live input. Scientific replay needs no foreign Git objects or network. Credit retains Philippe Van Velzen, ctoth, the actual-reader lineage and Nick Petalas's PR3506/3524/3535/3547.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3547's supplied map fails the named attachment. The binary degeneration fails both reader implications on subset dbhy, mask 43.
- After: separate Gaussian and integer-minor/GF4-annihilator implementations agree on all 64 star subsets, 256 implications and all extremal premises. The primary also checks 32 base and 16 difference subsets. Eight optimized real-CLI corruptions reject; eight restored runs pass.
- CPython 3.12.15 registered replay, metadata/pins, focused Ruff/format, actual final-head byte/source-history check, official export integrity and all three optimized Git-free scientific/control commands pass at `15955062f27faa2d5e3a15d850125b6011452d43`. Source/export/runtime hashes and source/export inode-disjoint checks are preserved.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-alternate-star-transfer
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-alternate-star-transfer --check-source-history
```

Author-written proof complete. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Other failed placements, odd-characteristic old configurations, larger/repeated interfaces, native acquisition/coefficients/frames/restoration, hosting, precision, stock, compiler/all-size admission and complete paid consumers remain open. The original physical coverage-law card's acceptance gate remains unmet; the changed scope is explicit in TASK.json.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19012364).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new opt-in research package. Frozen inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged.
